query: SELECT id AS "id!: String" FROM record_identities WHERE kind = 'move' AND json_extract(payload, '$.record.moveName') = ? AND json_extract(payload, '$.record.requester.actor.identity.kind') = 'session' AND json_extract(payload, '$.record.requester.actor.identity.session.endpoint.serviceId') = ? AND json_extract(payload, '$.record.requester.actor.identity.session.endpoint.endpointId') = ? AND json_extract(payload, '$.record.requester.actor.identity.session.sessionId') = ? AND json_extract(payload, '$.record.outcome.kind') = 'rejected' ORDER BY id
